title: BCGDRP: drug-conditioned multimodal learning for drug response prioritization in unseen cancer cell lines
description: Code, trained models, analysis scripts, and source data for BCGDRP, a drug-conditioned multimodal framework evaluated under cell-line-disjoint drug-response prediction. The release includes reproducibility checks, response-statistics baselines, cross-screen evaluation, disease-focused hold-outs, and replicate-level dose-response source data. Third-party inputs governed by provider-specific licences are documented but not redistributed.
